ghi_chu: SUA LOI DOI MOI PT KHI CHUA DUNG CUNG CHO. Chu pt dang giua mot chuyen di do vong cay phat ra thi bi doi bay ve diem hen — nhung chuyen cu VAN CHAY NOT va keo no qua cua sang map khac, keo theo ca acc vua vao party. Roi doi moi party 2 phut sau do, luc chu pt da lac. Nay: thu hoi chuyen di cu truoc khi bay ve diem hen; vong cay cung phai nhuong nhu cac viec khac; kiem map NGAY TRUOC khi moi; va doi thieu nguoi vi moi truot thi watchdog tu gom lai sau 3 phut.
